name: Feature Request
description: Propose a new capability or simulation model for Aegis Earth
labels: ["enhancement"]
body:
  - type: markdown
    attributes:
      value: Propose improvements for risk scoring, disaster simulations, or UI telemetry!
  - type: textarea
    id: feature
    attributes:
      label: Feature Description
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: use-case
    attributes:
      label: Use Case / Impact
    validations:
      required: true
